messages.text: Ladder's up. Snappers, Metros, Monarchs, Bullies, Philly Funk. Weakest to strongest.
so we start at the bottom. fitting

that's actually correct. I hate it
Climb all five, then the bracket. Win that and we're out the East.
The East don't care where you from, youngin. Only where you finish.
New York first. let's work
Yo who is {crew}? Asked the whole block. Even the bodega cat ain't heard of y'all.
We the {rival}. Real ball. 90s ball. We kick like it's '94 forever.
we'll see saturday
Saturday's good. If the train's running. If not, Sunday. Maybe.
THE BODEGA CAT DON'T KNOW US 😭 that's disrespectful to the whole block

so we gotta be FASTER THAN TRAFFIC 🏎️💨

Hon. Look at the logo. 👑
HE CALLED YOU HON 😭😭

not this time

keep the numbers. run it back

you serious?

{crew}. Lou again. Twenty years I've run this bracket.
